quest.title: A Mysterious Loss
quest.description: Many meteorites have landed outside the city of Mondstadt, wreaking havoc everywhere. Viktor appears to have lost something important, and is talking to himself, flummoxed...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Essence x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Oh, this is terrible. I'm finished for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Gah! Staying here was just too boring, what with the weird looks the sisters give me and all, so I decided to get out, get some fresh air...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But just as I left the city, thinking to go to the Thousand Winds Temple for a stroll... all these meteorites started raining down from the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: There was no way I was staying out there, so I ran back into the city... And that's when I realized that I left a box behind...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Given all the chaos out there, I didn't dare to go out to look for it, either.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: And, well... I'm Fatui. If I were to make any sudden moves, I'd be suspected of doing something untoward for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Bah, enough nonsense. Could you help me look for that thing?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Our transactions have been quite amiable so far, and I plan to continue doing good business with you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stop saying such suspicious stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What? Come now, there was nothing suspicious about the stories I told you...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well, how about it? Will you help me out, or won't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help you out.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's great. Now, let me think... While I can't remember the details, I was wandering around the Thousand Winds Temple earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But as I was running back, I encountered a large group Electro Slimes. I got careless and took a few hits from them, and the box fell out...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Now, I did manage to grab it back, but... I wound up losing it again in my haste.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Still, since the box was touched by those Electro Slimes, it should have some elemental traces on it.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: In any case, try following the trail of Electro traces and see what you can find.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Once you've found the box, bring it back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well... <color=#00E1FFFF>you can also come back and look for me if you really can't find it</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'll give it a bit more thought. Maybe I'll remember something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bit hard to search without leads, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Um, alright, one moment. Let me try to remember...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: No, nothing comes to mind. There's nothing special about the box, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then if I may ask you something...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Sure. What would you like to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's in the box?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's, uh, none of your business. Just a few odds and ends...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Come on! Don't look at me like that. I'm not some kind of villain!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you're with the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Fatui this, Fatui that... So all of us are the bad guys now? What sort of logic is that?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. Go out there and have a look. <color=#00E1FFFF>Come back and look for me if you really can't find it</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'll give it a bit more thought. Maybe I'll remember something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened while you were running back here?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: While I was running back? Hmm, let's see... No, I can't recall any details.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! I did encounter a large group of Electro Slimes near the <color=#00E1FFFF>Thousand Winds Temple</color> on the way back. They gave me a few hard knocks, causing the box to fall out!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Now, I did manage to grab it back, but... I wound up losing it again in my haste.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Still, since the box was touched by those Electro Slimes, it should have some <color=#00E1FFFF>elemental traces</color> on it.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: In any case, try following the trail of Electro traces and see what you can find.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Once you've found the box, bring it back to me.

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the lost box

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you doing out there?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Oh, come on. What's with that look of suspicion?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I just went out for a stroll, really! I legged it back here the moment those meteorites started falling.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. Go out there and have a look. <color=#00E1FFFF>Come back and look for me if you really can't find it</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'll give it a bit more thought. Maybe I'll remember something...

talks.objective: Go to the Thousand Winds Temple to search for Viktor's lost box

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What? Did you need something else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a little hard to search without any clues, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Um, alright, one moment. Let me try to remember...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: No, nothing comes to mind. There's nothing special about the box, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then if I may ask you something...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Sure. What would you like to know?

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find Viktor's lost box

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Have you found that box?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it right here.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: You... actually managed to find it! Phew... That's good... That's good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And as for our "deal"?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Uh, fine... Fine, I get it. Out with it, then. What do you want to know this time?

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find Viktor's lost box

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the other Fatui in the city?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Oh, them? They're probably spinning their wheels here, just like me.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder when these days will finally end...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what do you know about the meteorites?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: The meteorites... Well, not that I don't want to tell you, but I have no clue either.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: All I do is stand here in Mondstadt, unable to leave or move. What do I know?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But my gut feeling tells me that those meteorites don't bode well...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'd stay out of this one if I were you. It can only mean trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What? Did you need something else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a little hard to search without any clues, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Um, alright, one moment. Let me try to remember...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: No, nothing comes to mind. There's nothing special about the box, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then if I may ask you something...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Sure. What would you like to know?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's all I can remember. Find me that box, and quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: If you can't, well... then I'm done for...
